contracts.docstring: Explicit end of an observed closed local reservation; original closure comes from trusted stores, never from the caller.
Close one original local reservation after verified closure, retaining files/history and requiring a separate request for subsequent adoption.
Reconcile exact original sealed Git or never-reserved closure before ending its reservation; never signal a different owner or infer closure from path absence.
Persist bounded original setup intents and directory ownership through the existing SQLite/project-metadata transaction.
Expose complete recorded source intentions and point-in-time observations without peer internals or an implied fresh Git check.
Require the original administrative owner/fence and database identity before any directory or peer control.
Share original source admission inside an existing transaction so HTTP ownership can be persisted atomically before its first client.
Fence an already-closed original attempt and retain its history before a new strictly readonly reconciliation; never restart its writes.
Persist explicit continuation before scheduling; replay may resume an unclaimed authorization at its original fence, never an admitted or unknown writer.
Classify persisted original local closure with matching origin/attempt/domain or drained pre-domain ownership; grant/path absence alone is insufficient.
End one exactly observed closed local preparation without changing files, deleting history, registering Git or reviving old writer authority; exact replay returns its receipt.
Retain an interrupted/failed operation and its original directories/peers; absence of a reply does not authorize another Git write.
Expose a bounded redacted current issue while retaining the original operation, physical receipts and any partial files for explicit observation.
Own actual administrative worker handles without inventing native turns or replaying interrupted writes after restart.
Expose saved phase and actual local worker observation; a stopped local worker never proves remote rollback or fresh Git health.
Validate a selected historical identity/fence before scheduling readonly recovery; no implicit setup write or different current attempt is substituted.
End an observed closed local reservation after original closure proof; replay reads only its receipt and cannot withdraw a later adoption owner.
A live source cannot be released; after actual Stop, one original release allows adoption while old replay/repair/observe cannot withdraw the new owner or change files.
Hold only real original owners between fixed stages, without replacing Git results or physical retirement receipts.
A real admitted but unclosed administrative owner is not released from directory absence or a body containing a fake closure claim.
Stop and release of a planned intent retain its never-claimed proof, create no folder and make old repair authority unusable.
A cancelled real SQL-to-HTTP handoff can replay an unclaimed repair at the same original fence; an admitted or completed writer is never reissued.
Stop the actual original owner between successful init and any initial commit.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery. Relevant new frontend modules and exported helpers also carry English JSDoc; no claim that all historic project definitions are documented.
